levels.descriptor: Writes down what happened in a match in plain sentences.
Writes a one-line note with what, why it matters and what next.
Writes a full match report that a coach can act on.
Sets the writing standard for a department and edits others.
Follows one player for a few minutes and lists what they do.
Separates what a player does on the ball from off the ball.
Judges a player's role fit across several live matches.
Trains scouts to observe consistently and defend the verdict.
Knows the pitch, the lines and the basic shapes of a team.
Names a team's shape in and out of possession.
Explains why a team presses, builds up or defends the way it does.
Reads the game live and adjusts the plan within minutes.
